324.name: Highway Racing
324.content:
![highway racing](/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/hr1.png)

Highway Racing Driving Arcade Machine is a multi-platform arcade system with a patented design. The Highway Racing Driving Arcade Machine is compatible with Xbox 360, Xbox One, PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, PC, JAMMA Boards and late model arcade game boards. This is all plug and play, where you can switch between the gaming systems with ease, and changing a game can be as simple as changing a disc.
